Finland detains 17-year-old boy suspected of planning terrorist attack
articles.description: Finnish police are investigating a 17-year-old boy suspected of preparing a terrorist offence in Helsinki, with investigators examining possible links to religious extremism. Helsinki District Court ordered the teenager's detention on Saturday on probable grounds to suspect him of preparing a terrorist offence. The suspected activity took place on 2 November, although police said the date remains subject to further investigation.
